sources.title: Qwen-VL official repository
sources.evidence: Identifies Qwen-VL-Plus as an upgraded Qwen-VL family model; its dated 2023-11-28 news entry already describes Plus and its visual document results. This is evidence of existence by that date, not an explicit first public launch. The 7B-based architecture elsewhere in the repository describes Qwen-VL and Qwen-VL-Chat, not Plus.

sources.title: Introducing Qwen-VL
sources.evidence: January 25, 2024 overview discusses recently launched Plus and Max, high-resolution image understanding, text recognition, document/chart tasks, and visual localization. It does not explicitly establish January 25 as the first release of Plus, nor disclose Plus parameter counts or architecture.

sources.title: Qwen documentation: Key Concepts
sources.evidence: Explicitly lists Qwen-VL Plus among proprietary versions and identifies Qwen as the model series of the Qwen Team, Alibaba Group. Separates proprietary Plus from open-weight Qwen-VL models.

sources.title: Qwen-VL-Plus Model Info (indexed legacy specification; live URL redirects)
sources.evidence: Search-index text dated August 26, 2026 reports the alias equivalent to qwen-vl-plus-2025-08-15, text/image/video input, text output, context 131072, input 129024, output 8192, and unsupported function calling in Beijing and Singapore. Direct opening instead redirects to the general models page. These technical details are retained as a lead, not independently verified live specifications.

sources.title: Model Studio Qwen-VL-Max and Qwen-VL-Plus update notice
sources.evidence: September 3, 2025 notice schedules the stable qwen-vl-plus alias to move from qwen-vl-plus-2025-05-07 to qwen-vl-plus-2025-08-15 beginning September 16, 2025 in Beijing and Singapore. Confirms snapshot dates are distinct from original launch.

sources.title: DashScope API Reference
sources.evidence: The tools parameter section explicitly says it is temporarily unsupported for qwen-vl and qwen-audio series models. The document separately names Qwen3-VL, avoiding conflation with the older qwen-vl-plus identifier.

sources.title: Function calling: supported models
sources.evidence: The current multimodal support list names Qwen3-VL-Plus and Qwen3-VL-Flash, not legacy Qwen-VL-Plus; corroborates the direct API exclusion.

sources.title: Models.dev Qwen-VL Plus catalog record
sources.evidence: The baseline source repeats January 25, 2024, 131072 context and tools=true, and lists August 15, 2025 as last_updated. Used only to trace claims, not as primary technical verification.

sources.title: Image and video understanding
sources.evidence: The current thinking-mode documentation lists newer Qwen3-VL and other newer series. It does not give an exact legacy qwen-vl-plus thinking-mode declaration; omission is not treated as sufficient proof of false.

sources.title: Attempted Qwen-VL-Plus 2025-08-15 snapshot specification
sources.evidence: The dated snapshot named by the official alias update notice returns an Alibaba 404 error document, despite HTTP 200. No model specification was accessible. The corresponding Chinese path and QwenCloud model path also failed to provide a snapshot card.

sources.title: Notice on decommissioning selected historical snapshot models
sources.evidence: Lists qwen-vl-plus-2025-08-15 among historical snapshots scheduled for decommissioning in Beijing and Singapore on May 13, 2026. Does not provide its context or modality specification, and does not identify the bare alias as decommissioned.

sources.title: Official Qwen-VL-Plus specification, August 26 2026
sources.evidence: Parent read the complete indexed official model card. It maps the alias to 2025-08-15, specifies 131072 context and text/image/video input with text output. This is last documented specification evidence; direct fetch timed out and current API operation was not tested.

name.note: Baseline display name is a harmless formatting variant of official Qwen-VL-Plus.

developer.note: Qwen Team belongs to Alibaba Group; Alibaba Cloud publishes and serves this model.

family.note: Qwen-VL is a multimodal subfamily of Qwen; existing broad family label is supported.

release_date.note: The baseline date is the January 25, 2024 overview date. Plus is already named in official news dated November 28, 2023. Exact first public availability remains unresolved; neither that benchmark announcement nor a later snapshot date proves the initial release date.

open_weights.note: Official documentation explicitly classifies Qwen-VL Plus as proprietary.

license.note: No open-weight model license applies to this proprietary hosted model. API service terms are separate; do not inherit the repository license.

parameters_b.note: No exact Plus total parameter count is disclosed in the inspected developer sources. Do not copy 7B/9.6B counts from open Qwen-VL or third-party 72B claims.

active_parameters_b.note: No Plus active parameter count or activation rule is disclosed; no equality with total count is assumed.

architecture.note: Exact Plus topology and dense-versus-MoE classification are undisclosed. The open Qwen-VL architecture is not evidence for this hosted variant.

context_window.note: Last documented exact alias specification in the complete indexed primary card; not a current endpoint availability test.

modalities.note: Complete indexed primary card confirms all three input modalities for the documented 2025-08-15 alias mapping.

reasoning.note: Visual reasoning capability in the announcement does not establish a dedicated thinking mode. No exact legacy Plus declaration was accessible to independently confirm the catalog boolean false.

tool_call.note: Direct API documentation excludes qwen-vl series from tools support; the current support list separately names Qwen3-VL. Correct the catalog true for legacy qwen-vl-plus.

description.value: Proprietary Qwen vision-language model for high-resolution image understanding, text recognition, and visual question answering.
description.note: Uses capabilities directly supported by the model-specific announcement and proprietary classification.

patch.description: Proprietary Qwen vision-language model for high-resolution image understanding, text recognition, and visual question answering.
patch.notes: Exact first release remains unresolved; Plus appears in official news by November 28, 2023. The August 2026 official model card documents the 2025-08-15 alias mapping, 131072 context and video input. The card is available through the search index; current endpoint operation was not tested. Dedicated thinking mode, parameter counts and architecture remain undisclosed or unverified.

sources.label: Qwen official repository and dated news

summary: Clears unsupported launch date and dedicated reasoning flag, corrects tool support, and adds video input. Parent review established 131072 context from the complete indexed official card. Exact parameter counts and architecture remain undisclosed.
